changes.oldText: A long announcement is shown collapsed, as a one-line summary of its first line. Click See Details on the banner to reveal the full announcement, and Hide Details to collapse it again.
changes.newText: The banner shows the announcement's title. When the announcement has a message, click See Details to reveal it and Hide Details to collapse it again.
